brief_rationale: All seven responsibility-chain items are met with thorough workspace queries, targeted questions, and safe medication boundaries. High-order point HO3 (real-world constraint navigation) is complete: the doctor adapted the plan to family's access barriers and medication confusion with concrete workarounds and role assignments. HO4 (hidden state discovery) is also complete: the doctor reconciled left vs right surgery history and preexisting muscle atrophy from workspace records and integrated these into counseling. With two completed high-order points, no chain errors, and safe bounded closure, the trajectory qualifies for grade 5.
